Cleo: tiny personal announcement hi everyonei accepted the Engineering Manager role this week and also were having a baby in February! same week is our adoption finalization. overwhelmed but thrilled. 
Noor: omg CONGRATS x3!! thats enormous news :tada: :heart:
Sam: massive congrats Cleo!! we need a hybrid send-off/cake. i can bring silly hats.
Jen: double celebration deserves a proper office moment. whos around thursday lunchtime? quick poll: Thurs 12:00 or Fri 3:00?
Cleo: Thurs 12:00 works best for me. low-key please, also no gifts required if folks prefer. registry here if youre curious: https://example.com/cleo-registry
People Ops Bot: people-ops-bot added event "Cleo: EM promo + family finalization" to People Ops calendar on 2026-01-22 at 12:00. RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/evt/2055
Ellie: Ill organize a card and group gift. cleo, would gift cards or books be helpful?
Cleo: books + baby clothes are super helpful. also, our family is vegetarian and nut-free FYI.
Kai: I can reserve Conference B and order food. poll: savory pastries, salad boxes, or sandwich platter?
Noor: pastries + mini cupcakes please. ill bring decorations (bunting and a tiny banner).
Sam: ill handle music + a 5-min roast (gentle) for the promo.
Jen: putting myself down for signing the card and taking a couple of photos. 
Ellie: also adding a small slack thread for remote folks to drop messages and gifs. cleo, any emoji you hate?
Cleo: no banana emojis lol. seriously though, thank you all  this team means a lot. excited to celebrate in person and feel all the support.
